title: Cache discipline: stale-while-revalidate reads and explicit write invalidation
iWant: instant screens that quietly stay current
soThat: I never stare at spinners for data the application already had, or act on data it should have refreshed

acceptanceCriteria.description: Server state and UI state are held in separate mechanisms; view state (selection, panels, drafts) never enters the server-state cache.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the separation holds with no view state in the query cache

acceptanceCriteria.description: A route with cached data renders the cached view immediately while revalidating in the background; a change from revalidation updates in place without a loading flash.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a previously visited route with cached data
acceptanceCriteria.then: content is instant, then silently refreshed

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every mutation declares the cache entries it invalidates; affected views reflect the write without manual refresh.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a mutation touching a cached collection
acceptanceCriteria.then: the collection view shows the change on next render

acceptanceCriteria.description: Optimistic updates render immediately where declared, and on failure roll back visibly with an error state explaining the reversal.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a declared-optimistic mutation forced to fail
acceptanceCriteria.then: the optimistic change reverts and the user is told why

acceptanceCriteria.description: Concurrent identical reads deduplicate into one request.
acceptanceCriteria.given: two components mounting with the same query key

acceptanceCriteria.description: Cache keys derive from canonical resource URLs so invalidation addresses resources exactly and misses nothing that displays the written resource.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a resource displayed on two routes
acceptanceCriteria.when: the resource is mutated from one
acceptanceCriteria.then: both routes show the new value on next render
